and then you have so many options in pretty much all the languages, and then off you go. And that

encourage people to do? Because each and every step, each and every translation, increase a little

making it slower. But the fact that this is possible is still very cool. WebAssembly has a very,
very opinionated and good memory model that prevents you from CBEs using a separate heap. And so, in

parallelism. This is a no-go as of today. So, if your application needs a lot of performance, and
